svg.text: ROOF BOX — I/O wall to devices · internal wiring
QILIPSU 410 x 310 x 180 · wall sockets seen from inside (solder-cup side) · I/O row 52 mm above the floor
4 sealing elements: dish · LAN · beacon cord · blind
input leads 30 cm (supplied), soldered to the SP21 cups
SP1312/S2 · wall socket, beacon cord plugs in outside
STARLINK_13V · converter red lead, crimp pin
STARLINK_GND · converter black lead, crimp pin
ES_RX (ALWAYS-ON) · receiver red 18 AWG, crimp pin
RX_GND · receiver black 18 AWG, crimp pin
RX_STAT · receiver white (out 1, sourcing), crimp pin
captive coax from the lid dome · connect last
57 V · supplied lead + barrel plug (98 cm)
Starlink cable, moulded plug · through the gland first
outdoor Cat6 10 ft, moulded RJ45 · to the cab switch
data — Starlink dish / LAN, moulded cables
HD34 cavity J (ES_RX) and the receiver RED lead are live with the kit master switch OFF.
The feed comes from the enclosure safety chain, upstream of the master relay.
No solder anywhere: every conductor ends in a size-16 crimp pin pushed into the receptacle rear · the seven unused cavities take 114017 sealing plugs · beacon cord enters through the gland uncut
Wire table: roof-harness-definition.md (2026-09-01) · dish and LAN plugs are moulded, never cut · connect the dome lead only after the dome is bolted to the lid and the receiver is on its bracket
